source.publisher: Federal University of Viçosa, Department of Animal Science
source.title: Brazilian Tables for Poultry and Swine — Composition of Feedstuffs and Nutritional Requirements

notes: Table 1.01 feedstuffs are stored on the published as-fed basis.
Table 1.09 crystalline amino acids are published on a dry-matter basis; their provenance records this exception explicitly.
Table 1.10 inorganic mineral sources are stored on the published as-fed basis.
Legacy PigFlow ingredient IDs are retained only where the Brazilian source identity is an exact or explicitly documented compatible mapping.
Missing Brazilian source values remain missing. PigFlow only treats narrowly defined nutrient families as structural zero by ingredient category.
Ingredients without a defensible Brazilian Tables identity were removed from the canonical formulation library rather than silently retaining another database.
Ingredient identity and provenance are stored once; species-specific nutrient values live under nutrition.swine and nutrition.poultry.

notes: Legacy PigFlow ID retained for compatibility where applicable.
Lysine concentration is derived only from Table 1.09 nitrogen values: Lysine-HCl N% divided by pure lysine N%; SID concentration then applies the published standardized digestibility.
Brazilian Table 1.09 publishes standardized metabolizable energy (MESn35), not ordinary ME; PigFlow preserves it separately and does not relabel it as ME.
